votes.motion: Ratify the determination that the Council continue meeting remotely and without an anchor location under HB5002.
votes.description: The Council ratified the chair's determination to continue holding meetings electronically and without a physical anchor location, as permitted under Utah HB5002 and the City's Emergency Proclamation.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 3 of 2021, extending a proclamation declaring a local emergency relating to the COVID-19 (Coronavirus) pandemic, until May 5, 2021.
votes.description: The Council extended the Mayor's March 10, 2020 COVID-19 local emergency declaration through May 5, 2021, continuing emergency authorities related to the pandemic.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 4 of 2021, extending a proclamation declaring a local emergency relating to a magnitude 5.7 earthquake, until May 5, 2021.
votes.description: The Council extended the Mayor's March 18, 2020 earthquake emergency declaration through May 5, 2021, preserving City options for federal funding related to the earthquake.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 5 of 2021, extending a proclamation declaring a local emergency relating to the Windstorm until May 5, 2021.
votes.description: The Council extended the Mayor's September 8, 2020 windstorm local emergency declaration through May 5, 2021, continuing emergency authorities related to that event.

The Council approved a package of items including setting public hearing dates for three zoning ordinances, approving grant holding account items (Batch No. 4) for FY2020-21, and approving board appointments and reappointments.
